about: Names for event and invitation actions that a review of red line 2 wrote to get round its phrases, after the rule was written, plus reads with the same nouns. The phrases added after that review were chosen from these names, so this list shows what the review fixed, not how the rule does on names it has not seen (google-workspace-calendar.json is that).
source: a code review of this repository, 31 Oct 2026; the names are the reviewer's
